Built for speed, agility, and raw trail feedback, the Strappers are the ultimate barefoot trail running shoes for off-road runners. The breathable, debris-defying mesh upper keeps your feet clean and cool. Lace up the Strappers and discover a fast, natural, and completely connected trail running experience.
